text:
thorin_customer_ops: Quick heads-up — Thalassa onboarding latency is up ~20% over the last 48h after a bump in prompt length. Can we propose a low-risk perf plan? Thinking compact quant swap for the generation route + split-routing short completions to a smaller model. Ping @lydia_cs @jamal_eng :wave:
lydia_cs: Thanks for flagging. Can you drop the latest p95/p50 and peak tokens/s? Also what SLA tier are they on?
thorin_customer_ops: p50=220ms -> 195ms, p95=980ms -> 1180ms (over 48h). Peak concurrent reqs ~85, avg tokens/req up ~15%. They're on Standard (non-dedicated) right now. Link to dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/thalassa/latency
jamal_eng: Ok. High-level plan: 1) run a 5% canary to compact-int8 variant, 2) enable prefix KV cache on hot routes, 3) split-route short completions (<64 tokens) to redwood-lite. Low-risk fallback to current model if regressions.
jamal_eng: Suggested route config for canary (example):
```
route {
  model: "redwood-compact-int8-v2"
  fallback: "redwood-std-v2"
  canary_pct: 5
  batch_target: 16
  prefix_cache: true
}
```
lydia_cs: Nice. What's the expected unit cost delta and latency gains? I want to set customer expectations before enabling.
jamal_eng: Expect ~10-15% token-cost reduction and ~8-12% p50 latency improvement after warmup on generator paths. p95 improvements depend on burst smoothing; we'll watch it. Regression risk: hallucination/quality should be minimal but we'll run prompt eval set.
tanya_enablement: I'll coordinate the eval set and run it through the canary prompts. Recommend: canary for 48h, collect accuracy/regression metrics and top-10 prompt diffs. I'll post results to #eng-ml if any >2% delta.
thorin_customer_ops: Customer ok with canary window tomorrow AM. Can we avoid changes during their peak at 15:00 UTC?
jamal_eng: Yep — we can schedule at 10:00 PT (convert to 17:00 UTC) — that conflicts with their peak. Can we do 08:00 PT instead? That lands at 15:00 UTC. Hmm. Let's do 06:00 PT (13:00 UTC) to be before the peak.
lydia_cs: I'll send a short customer note with expected outcomes: ~12% cost saving, ~10% typical latency win, fallback plan and monitoring cadence. Will mention we'll capture a sample diff deck. :thumbsup: 
thorin_customer_ops: Thanks — please mention the short-completions split (saves latency for the small stuff).
deploy-bot: Canary job started: job-id=canary-thalassa-6174020001, percent=5, model=redwood-compact-int8-v2, started_at=6174020050
jamal_eng: Initial warmup results (first 30m): p50 down 11%, p95 down 9% on canary traffic, token cost estimator showing ~13% lower unit cost. No quality alerts yet from eval harness.
tanya_enablement: Running prompt eval now — will push diffs in ~2h.
lydia_cs: I'll follow up with customer note in 15m and attach rollback contact and expected rollback criteria (any >3% user visible error or >5% quality regression).
thorin_customer_ops: Appreciate it. After 48h canary and positive eval, let's scale to 25% then full. Schedule a 30-min sync with Thalassa CSM + Eng next Friday.
jamal_eng: Sounds good. I'll keep monitoring and post real-time metrics to the thread. :satellite: 
thorin_customer_ops: Great — thanks all.
